profiles.selector_label_it: Quality Label ESC50: welcome and/or support; explicit role

scoring.note_it: Official positive/negative evaluation without points. The IDEA checklist guides the adequacy of the concept; it does not certify the release of the label or automatic access to funds.

checks.official_focus_it: Convincing and clearly explained reasons for participating in the European Solidarity Corps.
checks.idea_question_it: Why does this organization want to play its chosen ESC role?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Profile of the organization and initial motivation linked to its work. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Comparison between motivations, ordinary work and proposal in the form.
checks.design_implication_it: Define the purpose of the organization and the contribution of the host/support role.

checks.official_focus_it: Ordinary objectives and activities relevant to the ESC objectives, with a strong solidarity dimension.
checks.idea_question_it: Which part of the ordinary work expresses solidarity and responds to ESC objectives?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Available examples of motivated activities or intentions and needs addressed. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check consistency with ESC objectives and rooting in real work.
checks.design_implication_it: Starting from social needs and linking volunteer activities to the organizational mandate.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance with respect to the respect and promotion of shared EU values ​​​​​​and the fight against any discrimination.
checks.idea_question_it: How will EU values ​​​​and the non-discriminatory approach guide activities and access?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial principles and an example of methodological or access choice. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check EU values ​​​​​​in objectives, methods, activities and expected results.
checks.design_implication_it: Translate dignity, freedom, democracy, equality, rule of law and human rights into concrete choices.

checks.official_focus_it: Selection and/or involvement of participants through a transparent and fair process.
checks.idea_question_it: How will young people be identified and involved without discriminatory barriers?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Recruitment scheme, hypothesized channels and motivation-focused criteria. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify process, use of ESC portal and fair policies consistent with activities.
checks.design_implication_it: Design accessible selection and divide tasks with partners.

checks.official_focus_it: Adequate practical and logistical arrangements.
checks.idea_question_it: What accommodations and services will make the activity possible in the planned locations?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Assumptions about travel, visas if necessary, accommodation, meals and local transport. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check the feasibility and adequacy of the agreements for each location and type of business.
checks.design_implication_it: Sizing locations and participants based on logistical resources.
checks.applicability_it: Host: accommodation and conditions at the venues; support: preparation/assistance for the trip and liaison with hosts, according to actual responsibilities.

checks.official_focus_it: Adequate support for participants before, during and after the activity, according to the role.
checks.idea_question_it: Who will support the young people in preparation, during the experience and upon return?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial map of supports and contact persons by phase. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check preparation, applicable Training and Evaluation Cycle, contacts and return support.
checks.design_implication_it: Assign support continuity and host/support transitions.
checks.applicability_it: Support: preparation, contact and return; host: welcome and support during the activity; explicit shared tasks.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevant suitability and specific preparation requirements, especially when working with vulnerable groups, in accordance with applicable national law.
checks.idea_question_it: Can the activities involve vulnerable people and what preparation/suitability will need to be checked?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Type of recipients, initial protection needs and regulatory verification plan. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check suitability and training requirements that are actually applicable and their implementation.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide permissible tasks, preparation and checks before contact with vulnerable recipients.
checks.applicability_it: Both roles for their respective tasks; specific preparation and checks when required by the nature of the activities and applicable law.

checks.official_focus_it: Adequate personal support for participants.
checks.idea_question_it: Who can young people turn to for wellbeing, difficulties and integration?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Hypotheses on mentors, referents and access to personal support. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check the quality and availability of support, adapted to the role and needs.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide mentorship, listening and integration into the community.

checks.official_focus_it: Strong learning component and recognition and validation of learning outcomes.
checks.idea_question_it: What will participants learn and how will they reflect on that learning?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial learning outcomes, educational activities and hypothesized tools. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check mentoring, regular reflection, documentation and recognition of learning; Youthpass/Europass encouraged and final certificate.
checks.design_implication_it: Link tasks to learning outcomes and plan support and recognition.

checks.official_focus_it: Security and protection of participants and recipients, consistent with the principle of avoiding harmful activities.
checks.idea_question_it: What initial risks concern young people and recipients and what measures can prevent them?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: First map of risks/vulnerabilities and possible measures by location and activity. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify prevention, incident response and safe conditions for all involved.
checks.design_implication_it: Rule out malicious activity and allocate enforcement responsibilities and resources.

checks.official_focus_it: Avoid job substitution, routine tasks and tasks with little learning impact.
checks.idea_question_it: Do volunteers' tasks add solidarity and learning without supporting functions that are the responsibility of paid staff?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Examples of tasks and initial distinction from the work of the staff. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify that volunteers do not replace staff and that the ordinary service does not depend on them; limit your routine.
checks.design_implication_it: Redesign tasks and supervision when professional routines or responsibilities prevail.

checks.official_focus_it: High-quality activities that respond to unmet social needs and benefit participants, communities and recipients.
checks.idea_question_it: What unmet needs do the proposed tasks address and who will benefit?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial description of needs, tasks and beneficiaries, with in-depth method. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify rationale, quality and benefits of standard activities for relevant locations.
checks.design_implication_it: Connecting need, volunteer task, learning and social benefit.
checks.applicability_it: Both roles; standard activities required for host and optional for support, where they describe activities supported/coordinated with host.

checks.official_focus_it: Reach, support and engage young people with fewer opportunities.
checks.idea_question_it: Which young people are at risk of exclusion and how will they be reached and supported?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Assumptions about groups, barriers, outreach channels and additional supports. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify outreach, selection, equal participation and justified supports, including through specialized partners.
checks.design_implication_it: Adapt access, tasks and support to needs, without requiring mandatory previous experience.
checks.applicability_it: Host/support second role; Not having previous experience requires a credible approach, not automatic exclusion.

checks.official_focus_it: Ability and commitment to assign appropriate resources to manage ESC activities according to quality standards.
checks.idea_question_it: What people and resources can support the volume and quality of activity?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial estimate of resources, skills and management support. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check resources proportionate to the role, quality and capacity for inclusion, including plans for specific needs.
checks.design_implication_it: Dimension volunteering on organizational capacity and provide resources for inclusion.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate measures to ensure continuity in the event of organizational changes.
checks.idea_question_it: How will support and operations continue if staff, structure or locations change?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Main dependencies and substitution/continuity hypotheses. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check credible measures and management commitment in case of changes.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide for substitutes, transfer of responsibility and continuity of services.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate approach to identifying partners and collaboration.
checks.idea_question_it: Which partner profiles are needed and with what criteria will they be selected?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Necessary profiles and initial search and cooperation criteria. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check the partners' consistency, commitment and level of collaboration with respect to the objectives.
checks.design_implication_it: Define complementarity, responsibility and collaboration mechanisms.

profiles.selector_label_it: Quality Label ESC50: additional lead criteria

scoring.note_it: Maximum 50 + 50; at least 60/100 and at least 25/50 for each criterion; official national votes are integers. The label does not award funds; the approved score can be used in ESC51. IDEA hypotheses are not equivalent to an application score.

checks.official_focus_it: Convincing long-term framework for well-defined objectives, clear milestones and adaptation measures.
checks.idea_question_it: What long-term change are you looking for and what steps will allow you to verify and correct it?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial objectives, horizon, indicative milestones and adaptation hypotheses. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify concrete and measurable objectives in the monitoring and updateable activity plan.
checks.design_implication_it: Build change logic, milestones and correction decisions.

checks.official_focus_it: Objectives addressing important social needs and relevant to ESC objectives.
checks.idea_question_it: What unmet social needs motivate the goals?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial diagnosis and link to ESC goals. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify importance of needs, solidarity and benefit beyond just volunteers.
checks.design_implication_it: Anchoring goals to verifiable community needs.

checks.official_focus_it: Planned activities suited to identified needs and objectives.
checks.idea_question_it: How does each type of activity contribute to the goals?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial need-objective-activity map. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check consistency, number/type/duration and implementation capacity.
checks.design_implication_it: Choose activities as a means to the expected change.

checks.official_focus_it: Realistic and sufficiently ambitious targets in terms of objectives and capabilities.
checks.idea_question_it: What scale is credible with available resources and experience?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Indicative range of volunteers, activities, duration and resources with hiring. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify estimates including activities with partners and proportionality to organizational capacity.
checks.design_implication_it: Balancing ambition and resources without equating greater quantity with quality.

checks.official_focus_it: Clear benefits for participants, organizations and recipients and potential wider impact.
checks.idea_question_it: What benefits and changes are plausible for each group and beyond the activities?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Map of beneficiaries, expected results and impact hypotheses. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check plausibility, magnitude and observability of benefits without excessive attributions.
checks.design_implication_it: Distinguish outputs, benefits and impacts at relevant scales.

checks.official_focus_it: European added value of the planned activities and objectives.
checks.idea_question_it: What European contribution does the plan add compared to the solutions already available?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial comparison with similar initiatives and proposed European component. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: For in-country activities, verify complementarity with national services/schemes and explicit European value.
checks.design_implication_it: Designing motivated complementarity and European cooperation.

checks.official_focus_it: Accessible and inclusive activities and/or support for initiatives that address inclusion and diversity in society.
checks.idea_question_it: How does the plan promote access and inclusion and what social problem of exclusion does it address?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: First barriers, groups and adaptations, or social objectives of inclusion. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify concrete measures of inclusion and consistency with activities and resources.
checks.design_implication_it: Integrate inclusion into the plan and participation methods.

checks.official_focus_it: Promotion of sustainability and environmental responsibility, with sustainable practices in activities.
checks.idea_question_it: What practices will reduce the environmental impacts of activities and travel?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial choices on mobility, consumption and organization of activities. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check practices and relevant use of sustainable travel opportunities.
checks.design_implication_it: Includes environmental responsibility in operations and logistics.

checks.official_focus_it: Planned use of digital tools and methods to integrate and improve activities.
checks.idea_question_it: Which digital use improves activity and participation?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Hypothesized tools and functions with benefits and possible barriers. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify proportionate use, accessibility and actual usefulness.
checks.design_implication_it: Choose digital that is functional to the objectives and support.

checks.official_focus_it: Quality management with adequate communication and coordination with partners.
checks.idea_question_it: How will the plan, responsibilities, risks and relationships with partners be governed?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial outline of roles, decisions, problem tracking and continuity. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify daily responsibilities, accountability, distribution of tasks, risk management and coordination.
checks.design_implication_it: Design a management structure commensurate with the plan.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate and quality measures to disseminate results inside and outside organizations.
checks.idea_question_it: Who will use or know the results and through which channels?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial recipients, communicable outcomes and hypothesized channels. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify a clear plan, proactive activities and visibility of results.
checks.design_implication_it: Link dissemination to recipients and useful results.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate and quality measures to monitor and evaluate activities.
checks.idea_question_it: How will we understand if activities, learning and support are working?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: First evaluation questions, indicators and possible sources. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check progress, quality of learning, effectiveness of supports and overall results.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide evidence collection and corrections during implementation.

profiles.selector_label_it: ESC51: allocation controls; no new award grille

scoring.note_it: ESC51 applications do not undergo a qualitative re-evaluation and do not apply award criteria. Amount determined by allocation rules, labels and performance/themes/inclusion; no threshold60/100 for new evaluation.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Simplified application based on the activities already approved in the Quality Label lead; label valid upon expiry.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: Is the allocation idea within the label and the approved plan or does it require an update first?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Known status of the label and initial correspondence of the activities, or path to verify them. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check validity of the lead label and approved activities at the time of application.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Use the approved plan as a dependency, without rewriting it in the simplified application.
idea_controls.applicability_it: ESC51; allocation criteria/programming, not awards. AIG/Italy where indicated.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Estimate of number, type and duration of activities and number of participants.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: What volume of activity is plausible and consistent with capacity and plan?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial ranges of activities, duration, participants and capacity. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check demand estimates and operational capacity; activities must follow the rules of their type.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Scale the request based on approved activities and capacity.
idea_controls.applicability_it: ESC51; allocation criteria/programming, not awards. AIG/Italy where indicated.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Allocation dependent on available budget, requested activities and minimum/maximum grant.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: What resource scenarios allow for a viable plan?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial scenarios and hypotheses of proportionate reduction. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check availability and agency rules; in the local AIG PDF min36,000€/year and max250,000€/year are not guaranteed amounts.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Predict scalable activities and sustainability under different assignment scenarios.
idea_controls.applicability_it: ESC51; allocation criteria/programming, not awards. AIG/Italy where indicated.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Approved Quality Label lead score as allocation input, without new award assessment.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: Is the approved label score available and how will it be used in the national route?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Existence/status of official score or plan to obtain receipt. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check official data and applicable allocation method, without simulating a new vote.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Treat the score as historical external input, not new IDEA grid.
idea_controls.applicability_it: ESC51; allocation criteria/programming, not awards. AIG/Italy where indicated.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Applicant performance: progress report, budget absorption and final report of the last completed project, if available.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: What legacy performance is available and what scale would avoid under-utilization?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial inventory of performance and gap data to be verified. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check available reports/scores, absorption and national rules; Don't invent missing data.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Adapt scale to capacity and consider documented performance.
idea_controls.applicability_it: Previous data if available; lack of experience does not authorize you to invent scores.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Policy priorities and thematic areas of activities as allocation inputs.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: What really relevant priorities/topics do the activities address?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Candidate priorities/themes and link to approved activities. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check priorities/topics and current national formula for the call.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Maintain substantial coherence between themes and activities.
idea_controls.applicability_it: ESC51; allocation criteria/programming, not awards. AIG/Italy where indicated.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: Proportion of young people with fewer opportunities involved as allocation inputs.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: What involvement is realistic with adequate outreach and supports?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial assessment, groups/barriers and support measures. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check required proportion, justification and feasibility of supports.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Dimension inclusion on real capacity and equitable access.
idea_controls.applicability_it: ESC51; allocation criteria/programming, not awards. AIG/Italy where indicated.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: AIG may reduce the maximum per lead in corrective measures and limit funds for significant deviations from annual targets.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: Are there corrective measures or deviations that affect the request?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Know status and plan to verify notifications/targets; no presumption of findings. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check for any notifications and consistency with the approved annual targets.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Adjust scale and corrections if documented.
idea_controls.applicability_it: AIG/Italy allocation; only if corrective measures or relevant deviations are found.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: AIG recalls limit 25% of budget for participants from non-associated third countries, with published exceptions for Ukrainian nationals and up to 4voluntary projects; criterion to be respected already in the application.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: Does the hypothesized composition require quota control and exceptions?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial composition by origin and days/costs scenario. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check limits, exceptions, calculation required in the form and applicable version of the guide/call.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Size participants and days in compliance with applicable constraints.
idea_controls.applicability_it: AIG/Italy, if participants affected by the quota are involved; verify the scope and relevance of the exceptions, without extending them to other routes.

idea_controls.official_focus_it: In the AIG PDF the quota for in-country volunteering cannot exceed 20% of the approved budget.
idea_controls.idea_question_it: Is the mix of in-country and transnational activities compatible with the constraint?
idea_controls.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial mix and share estimate of in-country activities. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
idea_controls.later_verification_it: Check calculation and 20% constraint according to guidance, provisions and actual calls.
idea_controls.design_implication_it: Size the mix of activities and resources on the applicable constraint.
idea_controls.applicability_it: AIG/Italy and in-country activities; constraint control, not award criterion.

scoring.note_it: Maximums 40/40/20; at least 60/100 and at least 20/20/10; official full NA grades. Ex aequo: relevance/motivation/impact, then management, then design. No independent scoring for the sub-points and no official rating for the idea alone.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance to ESC objectives and priorities.
checks.idea_question_it: What ESC objective/priority is addressed and what is it intended to achieve?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Concept objective and candidate priority with source to verify. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check consistency with objectives, priorities and ESC30 format of the call.
checks.design_implication_it: Define objectives and main results consistent with ESC30.

checks.official_focus_it: Consideration of ESC principles.
checks.idea_question_it: How does the idea express solidarity and address a social challenge?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Description of the solidarity dimension and relevant principles. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify ESC principles in activities and social benefit.
checks.design_implication_it: Integrate principles into group decisions and methods.

checks.official_focus_it: European added value through relevant themes.
checks.idea_question_it: Why does this local project address a common European issue?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial link between theme, aims, results and European dimension. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify European value even without transnational mobility.
checks.design_implication_it: Explain the contribution to a common European challenge.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance to the needs of group members.
checks.idea_question_it: Which needs of young promoters justify the project?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Needs declared or hypothesized by the group and consultation method. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check the needs of individual members and their relationship with objectives and activities.
checks.design_implication_it: Connect learning and accountability to member needs.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance to the needs of recipients, if any, and local communities.
checks.idea_question_it: Who in the community needs the intervention and how will demand be ascertained?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Initial group/community, problem and plan for comparison with them. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify rationale, identification of demand and community needs.
checks.design_implication_it: Design the intervention based on the community's real demand.
checks.applicability_it: Always local communities; specific target group if applicable.

checks.official_focus_it: Potential impact on members, including personal, entrepreneurial skills and social involvement.
checks.idea_question_it: What plausible changes will young people have during and after the project?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Expected benefits for members and hypotheses on the learning/action path. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Check contribution to initiative, creativity, citizenship and entrepreneurial skills.
checks.design_implication_it: Design responsibility and learning that produces benefits for the group.

checks.official_focus_it: Potential impact on recipients, if any, and local communities.
checks.idea_question_it: What realistic change can the community achieve?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Expected outcomes, beneficiaries and measurement hypotheses and timing. Hypotheses stated with sources to be consulted, method, person in charge and proportionate verification times are permitted.
checks.later_verification_it: Verify realistic estimate of the impact on local problems/opportunities.
checks.design_implication_it: Distinguish activities performed from expected community change.
checks.applicability_it: Always local communities; specific recipients if applicable.
